The bottom heat load for 16 theoretical trays and the feed on tray 15 can be estimated as follows:

12.14442 (for 15th tray) + (12.14469 - 12.14442) / (15 - 11) * (16 - 15) = 12.14469 - 0.00027 = 12.14442
